paragraphs.text:
You whistle loudly to show that you’ve heard nothing and amble 
away. But in the gloom you begin to see strangely cloaked figures 
shamble toward you from all sides. How stupid you were to have 
drawn attention to yourself!
If you can make a successful Climb roll you manage to get 
over a fence and safely beyond the grasp of the creatures, go to 
33. If you failed the Climb roll, go to 31. 
(194)
